why: Both proposals contain the same products: a light birch table for four, black chairs, a simple white bell pendant and a white-and-oak sideboard, all fitting the Nordic brief and the room's white walls and kitchen wood tones. The only near miss in each is the sideboard, whose gold legs and herringbone fronts are more glam than strictly Nordic and don't echo the black chairs. Since the two are identical, there is no basis to choose.
